cues.headline: GOAL! Teo Yarrow!
cues.body: Northbridge Athletic score! It's Northbridge Athletic 1–0 Ravenmoor United. Northbridge Athletic won it straight back and the move took 9 seconds.

cues.headline: Northbridge Athletic are on top
cues.body: Northbridge Athletic are on top: leaving Ravenmoor United just 4.0 passes per defensive action, forcing Ravenmoor United into 3 losses in their own half and playing 7 progressive passes in the last 5 minutes. Northbridge Athletic are already ahead, and still pushing.

cues.headline: Nobody's in charge now
cues.body: The game has settled. Ball over the last 5 minutes: Northbridge Athletic 35%, Ravenmoor United 65%. Neither team on top.

cues.headline: End to end now!
cues.body: Nobody can keep the ball: it's changing hands 5.6 times a minute. Anything can happen.

cues.headline: Ivo Quarry scores!
cues.body: Get in! Northbridge Athletic 2–0 Ravenmoor United. The broken game finally produced a goal. A long ball over the press set it up.

cues.headline: Thunderbolt!
cues.body: Niko Ashworth just hit the fastest shot of the match: 111 km/h.

cues.headline: It's all gone wild
cues.body: The ball is changing hands 6.2 times a minute. Neither side can calm it down.

cues.headline: It's in! Dario Valcourt!
cues.body: Dario Valcourt finds the net for Ravenmoor United: Northbridge Athletic 2–1 Ravenmoor United. It had been coming: Ravenmoor United were in control.

cues.headline: GOAL! Teo Abernath!
cues.body: Ravenmoor United score! It's Northbridge Athletic 2–2 Ravenmoor United. It had been coming: Ravenmoor United were in control. It came 6 seconds after Ravenmoor United won the ball high up the pitch.

cues.headline: All square out there
cues.body: It's even again: over the last 5 minutes Northbridge Athletic have had the ball 54% of the time, Ravenmoor United 46%.

cues.headline: Northbridge Athletic turn the screw
cues.body: Northbridge Athletic are calling the shots now: winning the ball back in the opposition half 5 times, forcing Ravenmoor United into 5 losses in their own half and leaving Ravenmoor United just 2.2 passes per defensive action in the last 5 minutes.

cues.headline: Ivo Quarry scores!
cues.body: Get in! Northbridge Athletic 2–3 Ravenmoor United. The broken game finally produced a goal.

recap.headline: Full time: Northbridge Athletic 2–3 Ravenmoor United
recap.summary: Ravenmoor United take the points, but Northbridge Athletic created more.
